name: 2048-jenkins-demo
description: 2048 game packaged as a static site, built/tested/deployed via Jenkins CI/CD

scripts.build: node -e "console.log('Build step: validating src/ files exist'); const fs=require('fs'); ['src/index.html','src/style.css','src/script.js'].forEach(f=>{ if(!fs.existsSync(f)) throw new Error(f+' missing'); }); console.log('Build OK');"
scripts.package: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('src/index.html','dist/index.html'); fs.copyFileSync('src/style.css','dist/style.css'); fs.copyFileSync('src/script.js','dist/script.js'); console.log('Packaged into dist/');"
